title: Grateful Dead Live at Universal Amphitheatre on 1973-07-01

ai_review.summary: Clean Miller soundboard captures a smoking ’73 show with unstoppable Big River, a monster Playing in the Band and The Other One, plus sublime China → Rider.
ai_review.review: The recording is an excellent Miller‑board soundboard capture—crisp, clear and expertly transferred. Musically the night shines with a high‑energy set highlighted by Big River, a blistering Playing in the Band > The Other One sequence, and a beautifully voiced China → Rider, while even the slower Loose Lucy feels right on the money.

ai_rating.rationale: All six reviews praise both the musical performance and the soundboard quality; standout songs are repeatedly mentioned, and no technical flaws are noted, warranting a top‑tier rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clean Miller board mix, crisp clarity, superb transfer; reviewers note no dropouts or muddy frequencies.

standout_songs: Playing in the Band > The Other One
show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong flow with a driving first half, a relaxed tempo on Loose Lucy, then building into an explosive Playing in the Band/Other One sequence; transitions feel natural and energetic.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for jamming hard on Big River (“Jer could have not liked it and jammed on it like that”).
